title: The golden workbook's stored values come from a non-converged circular calculation: cells defined as direct links do not equal their sources, so a correctly recalculated output cannot match the golden on sensitive cells.
evidence: Golden LBO G124 (=+G133) = 302.3311 but G133 = 302.5469. H132 (=G135) = 302.3311 but G135 = 302.5469. L103 (=+L135) = 1367.254 but L135 = 1373.241. Because L199 = L197 + L198 = 22.27 is small, a ~6 difference in L110 moves L199, L200 and L201 by about 25–30%, far outside the 1% tolerance.
confirmation: Golden LBO G124 (=+G133) caches 302.331 against G133=302.547, and L103 (=+L135) caches 1367.25 against L135=1373.24.
